levels.name: Sharp
levels.tagline: remembers what you took off it

help.goal: Collect books — all four cards of a rank. When the thirteenth book is laid down, whoever made the most wins.
steps: On your turn, tap a rank in your own hand.
Tap the player you want to ask for it.
If they hold any, you get all of them and ask again.
If not, go fish: you draw one card from the pond.
Draw the very rank you asked for and you carry on anyway.
Four of a kind lays itself down as a book.
notes: You may only ask for a rank you are already holding, so every ask tells the table something about your hand.
The asks list under the board is public — that is the whole game. Whoever asked for 7s is holding 7s.
If the pond runs dry and nobody can ask any more, the game stops there and the books are counted.
Run out of cards and you draw a fresh one from the pond, if there is one left.
The bots play from the same public list you do: Easy asks at random, Normal listens to the asks, Sharp also remembers what you took off it.
